name: [R15] PHP worker crash pattern consistent with PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618/109619)
message:
Traffic/logs match indicators of PHP2Shell: critical memory-safety vulnerabilities in core PHP itself (CVE-2026-109618, out-of-memory corruption enabling pre-auth RCE; CVE-2026-109619, stale global state across requests triggering a use-after-free), each CVSS 9.2, disclosed 2026-10-21 by Wiz Research, OpenAI Codex Security and Calif. Affects any PHP SAPI serving requests (PHP-FPM, mod_php, FrankenPHP), independent of the application on top -- pre-auth RCE was demonstrated against WordPress, Drupal and Joomla using only their latest container images (not app-specific bugs).

Because this is a PHP-runtime bug, not a request pattern, detection here is indirect like R16/R17 for Apache/Nginx: a PHP-FPM worker crash/restart signature, or separately a pre-fixed-version string still present in X-Powered-By. Neither is proof of exploitation alone -- confirm against the exact installed PHP version and php.net's own advisory. Fixed versions: PHP 8.2.35 / 8.3.36 / 8.4.27 / 8.5.12. Branches before 8.2 reportedly have no official fix per the disclosure site (php2shell.com) -- unverified beyond that source.

Tune: sites with expose_php=Off strip the version from X-Powered-By entirely, making the version-based case blind -- rely on the crash-pattern case instead. For a per-host authoritative version check (not a log-based lead), see security-scan/sqli-lab/auto_vuln_scanner.py's check_php2shell().

queries.name: php_fpm_worker_crash
queries.query: source:php-fpm (@message:*"exited on signal 11"* OR @message:*"exited on signal 6"* OR @message:*SIGSEGV*)

queries.name: php2shell_vulnerable_version_header
queries.query: source:webserver @http.response.headers.x_powered_by:PHP\/* -@http.response.headers.x_powered_by:(*PHP\/8.2.35* OR *PHP\/8.2.36* OR *PHP\/8.2.37* OR *PHP\/8.2.38* OR *PHP\/8.2.39* OR *PHP\/8.3.36* OR *PHP\/8.3.37* OR *PHP\/8.3.38* OR *PHP\/8.3.39* OR *PHP\/8.4.27* OR *PHP\/8.4.28* OR *PHP\/8.4.29* OR *PHP\/8.5.12* OR *PHP\/8.5.13* OR *PHP\/8.5.14* OR *PHP\/8.6.* OR *PHP\/8.7.* OR *PHP\/9.*)
